messages:
maria: Heads-up — HelioMetrics reported a duplicate renewal invoice hit this morning after they switched to PO terms (net-30) last week. Two invoices for the same subscription period showed up: INV-2026-0773 and INV-2026-0774. They say one was paid via PO (vendor AP) and the second via their saved card. Can finance confirm and refund the card charge while we investigate root cause?

olivia: Can you drop the customer and payment ids here so we can scope the refund quickly?

maria: Customer ID: CUST-998. Payment IDs: PI-555 (card charge), PI-556 (PO/ACH via vendor). Both invoices have same line items and tax. Webhook log snippets below — note two payment.succeeded events for the same amount (1200.00 USD) but different payment_method values. Both deliveries show 200 from our endpoint.

```
# webhook event A
event_id: evt_abc123
invoice_id: INV-2026-0773
payment_id: PI-555
payment_method: card_xxx
amount: 1200.00
status: payment.succeeded
webhook_response: 200 OK
received_at: 2026-03-17T09:12:17Z

# webhook event B
event_id: evt_def456
invoice_id: INV-2026-0774
payment_id: PI-556
payment_method: po_789
amount: 1200.00
status: payment.succeeded
webhook_response: 200 OK
received_at: 2026-03-17T09:12:18Z
```

alex: Thanks — finance here. If PI-555 is the card that cleared erroneously we can issue a full reversal/refund to the card. Do we want a refund or a credit note against the account? VAT is included — need to know whether the vendor PO (PI-556) triggered tax reclaim flow.

rahul: Quick triage notes from infra/billing: I see a race where PO attach webhook finished ~100ms after card capture path completed. There's a dedupe gap in the webhook-routing code: we dedupe by event_id only, but in this case the gateway created two distinct events for effectively the same invoice because we attached the PO after the initial invoice create. I'll open PR to dedupe on invoice_id + invoice_sequence.

billing-bot: webhook_delivered evt_def456 → 200 OK (src: payment-gateway, latency: 130ms)

alex: @maria go ahead and issue a refund to PI-555. I'll generate a credit memo after we confirm vendor payment landed. Refund reason: duplicate-charge. Tagging for audit: FIN-2231.

maria: Initiating refund now. Refund tool output: 
```
refunds.create(payment_id=PI-555, amount=1200.00, reason='duplicate-charge', initiated_by='maria')
status: initiated
refund_id: R-9001
```

refunds-bot: refund_initiated R-9001 for PI-555 amount 1200.00 USD — status: pending (expected settle 2-5 business days)

olivia: Noted — I told the customer we'll issue the refund and follow up once accounting confirms the vendor PO cleared. Customer appreciated the quick response :thumbsup:. Adding FIN-2231 to the audit queue and assigning to @alex for credit memo and tax handling.

rahul: I'll land the dedupe fix this afternoon and add a short-lived detection rule to alert if invoice_id is seen twice within 1m.

maria: Customer confirmed the duplicate charge refunded on their bank statement (they replied with screenshot). Closing on our side once FIN confirms credit memo.

olivia: closing loop — will update FIN ticket when memo posted. :white_check_mark:
